thread:
opsbot: ALERT: Canary group fastgen-canary crossed healthcheck threshold (28% failing, 5xx spike). Triggering page to eng-sre and oncall.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-176700 - canary-health-failure; severity: high; runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-failure
mira (oncall): on it, paging infra and release lead. checking dashboards now.
ash: saw the spike — quick glance at dashboards: request lat p95 -> 2.1s, 5xx rate up from 0.2% to 12% on canary. non-canary clusters look ok so far.
samir: logs show repeated «kv cache miss» exceptions then upstream 502s from model worker: snippets:
```
E model-worker: kv cache lookup failed, key not found
E http: upstream error 502: connection reset
```
beth: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for release/fastgen-2 started ~5m ago. Rolling to 6 pods, currently 4/6 passing.
leo: can we pause the rollout and prevent further canary traffic? what's the flag for the new fastpath?
mira (oncall): yes — hold traffic to canary and flip feature flag to safe state. I'm going to enable routing fallback to stable pool, and flip feature.fastpath=false in flags service. steps in runbook:
```
# pause canary traffic
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/pause -d '{"group":"fastgen-canary"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN'
# flip feature flag
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/set -d '{"flag":"feature.fastpath","value":false}'
```
ash: doing flag flip now.
ash: POST ok, flag set -> false. telemetry shows immediate drop in requests to canary.
samir: pausing rollout via k8s to slow any further pod changes: `kubectl scale deployment/fastgen-canary --replicas=0 -n prod-canaries`
beth: deploy-bot: noted scale to 0 command run by samir, stopping further canary pods from getting traffic.
leo: routing fallback in place, traffic should be routed to stable cluster, verifying.
mira (oncall): checking customer-impact channels: only a small subset of streaming sessions hit the canary. Support: please notify customers with degraded streaming if they open tickets. Realtime metrics show error budget hit for a handful of orgs — logging incident for account ops.
ash: quick check of model-worker container metrics — memory spike on new quantized image, GC thrash visible; looks correlated to new binary in canary image tag fastgen:quant-202603. Reverting image might be needed.
samir: agreement: plan A = flip flag + route fallback (done). Plan B = revert canary image (rollback) if 5xx persists after routing fallback.
opsbot: NOTE: Pager will auto-escalate in 10m if error rate stays >5% on canary group.
mira (oncall): calling release lead @ash and infra @samir — please be ready to roll back. ash, can you open the rollback PR or trigger rollback play?
ash: starting rollback job: `releasesctl rollback fastgen --to-tag=fastgen:stable-202602` — kicking off now.
ash: rollback job accepted by CI, deploy pipeline showing rollout to canary pool (stable tag). Estimated completion 4m.
beth: monitoring logs for 5xx trend.
samir: running quick healthcheck against canary health endpoint:
```
curl -sS https://canary.fastgen.health/healthz | jq .
{
  "liveness":"fail",
  "uptime": "3m"
}
```
leo: after flag flip + routing fallback, user-facing 5xx on prod dropped 85% — most traffic back to stable. Some backlog still touching canary pods until old sessions drain.
mira (oncall): good. keep rollback in flight until all canary pods replaced. no need for kill switch yet since flag flip achieved mitigation. if rollback fails, we'll flip the global kill switch for fastpath via admin console and consider capacity increase.
ash: rollback completed: new pods with stable tag are up. kubectl shows 6/6 ready now.
samir: re-checking logs: kv cache exceptions gone, upstream 502s not seen in last 2m.
opsbot: PING: error rate on canary group back under threshold. Auto-escalation canceled.
mira (oncall): de-escalating. Recommended follow-ups: add guardrail to quantized image CI, add canary preflight smoke that hits kv cache path, and increase canary log retention for 24h for root cause.
ash: filing post-incident ticket and will schedule follow-up RCA with model infra and release teams. PR: https://redwood.internal/changes/fastgen-canary-rollback-176700
beth: support notified, customer-impact list created for SOC and CSM teams.
leo: new action item: add a synthetic probe that exercises model-worker kv cache path during canaries. putting it in backlog with P0 for next sprint.
mira (oncall): handoff: I need to sign off in 15m, passing on to ash for follow-through. ash, you are the oncall owner for remediation items.
ash: ack. I'll own tickets and coordinate RCA.
mira (oncall): thanks team — good quick mitigation. closing thread once follow-ups are documented. :white_check_mark:
